transmission.note: BTC and SOL intervals cross zero. BNB is the clearest independent historical channel. Historical association, not a peg.

ESTABLISHED: GCC is a network of markets, not one market.
Recurring cross-pool dispersion and compression exist.
Mechanical/routing activity is material in the historical sample.
Corrective activity generates recurring measurable LP fees.
Raw dispersion does not equal executable arbitrage profit.
PARTIAL: BNB is the clearest historical transmission channel.

definitions.network_dispersion: Difference between implied GCC prices across connected pools.
definitions.corrective_activity: Transactions associated with cross-pool price compression in the historical sample; not proof of intent or automation.
definitions.effective_scarcity: GCC held at an address considered economically inaccessible; not a reduction in totalSupply.
definitions.lp_vs_hodl: Historical hypothetical difference between providing liquidity and holding the same starting assets.
definitions.connected_asset_transmission: Historical return association between connected quote assets and the GCC network reference; not causality or permanence.
definitions.solver_delta_nav: Change in controlled-wallet net asset value after execution costs.
definitions.evidence_status: Strength and scope of research support for a claim; distinct from live input confidence and model validation.

agent.availability: Research context only; opportunity types are not executable offers

metrics.label: Nominal GCC supply
metrics.description: The ERC-20 nominal supply reported by the contract.

metrics.label: Dead / inaccessible GCC
metrics.description: GCC held at the standard inaccessible address; this is not presented as a literal totalSupply reduction.

metrics.label: Effective inaccessible share
metrics.source: LE1-B10 / derived from nominal supply and dead balance
metrics.description: A supply-accessibility indicator, not a contract burn metric.

metrics.label: Explicit historical dead-address transfers
metrics.description: Transfers explicitly identified to the standard dead address in the bounded export.

metrics.label: Balance above explicit transfers
metrics.period: current observation minus explicit historical transfers
metrics.description: Consistent with reflection-style accumulation, but the exact attribution is not isolated by the available data.

metrics.label: Reflection-style token mechanics
metrics.description: The exposed interface includes reflectionFee, reflect, reflectionFromToken and totalFeesRedistributed alongside fee-account functions.

metrics.label: Canonical pools in LP study
metrics.description: Pancake WBNB, ApeSwap WBNB, BTCB, SOL-like and ICC pools. XAUT remains unresolved for historical series.

metrics.label: Cross-pool dispersion observations
metrics.description: Receipt and state observations used to study price disagreement; not all are unique opportunities.

metrics.label: Unique corrective-looking events
metrics.description: Historical events supporting event-level fee-side calculations; classification does not prove causal intent.

metrics.label: Corrective clean-leg DEX fee share
metrics.description: Share of estimated measurable clean-leg DEX fees associated with corrective-looking activity, not all historical fees.

metrics.label: Months with corrective candidates
metrics.description: Corrective fee candidates appeared in every observed month in the B7 sample.

metrics.label: Dispersion → fee Spearman
metrics.description: An observed association between initial dispersion and base fee across deduplicated events; not causality.

metrics.label: Pancake GCC/WBNB LP-vs-HODL median
metrics.description: Median historical hypothetical excess return for 12 normalized cohorts.

metrics.label: ApeSwap GCC/WBNB LP-vs-HODL median
metrics.description: Median historical hypothetical excess return for 10 normalized cohorts.

metrics.label: GCC/ICC LP-vs-HODL median
metrics.description: Median historical hypothetical excess return for 14 normalized cohorts.

metrics.label: GCC/BTCB LP-vs-HODL median
metrics.description: Median historical hypothetical excess return for 14 normalized cohorts.

metrics.label: GCC/SOL LP-vs-HODL median
metrics.description: Median historical hypothetical excess return for 10 normalized cohorts.

metrics.label: All LP-vs-HODL cohorts median
metrics.description: Across 60 hypothetical cohorts; 35 were negative. This is not a realized LP-owner return.

metrics.label: Equal BTC / BNB / SOL factor beta
metrics.description: Historical association with an equal crypto factor; no causal or permanent relationship is implied.

metrics.label: Conditional BNB coefficient
metrics.description: BNB was the clearest independent historical association in the multi-asset regression.

metrics.label: Autonomous transmission bridge ending index
metrics.description: Reduced-form external-transmission-only bridge; not a forecast.

metrics.label: Observed GCC network ending index
metrics.description: Observed historical index that is much larger than the reduced-form bridge; the residual is not assigned to a cause.

metrics.label: Daily volatility → corrective activity Spearman
metrics.description: Generic daily volatility was not useful as an explanatory variable; relative cross-pool dispersion is the more useful historical lens.

metrics.label: NET-2C direct-WBNB routes settled
metrics.description: 48 of 50 expanded direct-WBNB routes settled locally; two reference legs were unavailable.

metrics.label: NET-2C profitable direct routes
metrics.description: No tested direct-WBNB route produced positive post-cost ΔNAV.

metrics.label: NET-2C aggregate post-cost ΔNAV
metrics.description: Aggregate controlled-wallet net-asset change across the 48 settled routes.

metrics.label: NET-2C median trade ΔNAV
metrics.description: Median controlled-wallet net-asset change after execution costs.

metrics.label: NET-2C executable dispersion range
metrics.description: Observed N−1 dispersion range. Visible spread did not cross a post-cost break-even threshold.
